# hermes_cron_job (Resource)

Manages one profile-scoped Hermes cron job. The resource manages agent prompts and scheduler configuration; arbitrary shell scripts are deliberately excluded from this first contract.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile` (String) Lowercase Hermes profile that owns the job. Use `default` explicitly when intended.
- `schedule` (String) Hermes schedule expression, for example `every 1h` or a cron expression.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL override for this job.
- `context_from` (List of String) Optional IDs of jobs whose latest output is included as context.
- `deliver` (String) Delivery target such as `local` or a configured Hermes messaging platform. The target must exist in Hermes at runtime.
- `enabled_toolsets` (List of String) Optional Hermes toolsets enabled for this job.
- `model` (String) Optional model override for this job.
- `model_provider` (String) Optional model-provider override for this job. The API field is `provider`.
- `name` (String) Optional human-readable job name. Hermes derives one from the prompt when omitted.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the scheduler should keep this job paused. Pausing preserves the durable job definition.
- `prompt` (String) Prompt sent to the Hermes agent when the job runs. At least `prompt` or one `skills` entry is required.
- `skills` (List of String) Optional Hermes skills to invoke for the job.
- `workdir` (String) Optional working directory for the job.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_run_at` (String)
- `last_status` (String)
- `next_run_at` (String)
- `state` (String)
